ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low; high-intensity (white) pixels comprise less than 5% of the visible surface area against a near-uniform low-intensity (black) background.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid black base layer across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white contiguous blobs are clustered at the extreme lateral tips. Several isolated white punctate spots are visible on the left lobe surface at mid-lateral coordinates.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 115 degrees; notch depth is roughly 12% of the vertical height of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, low-amplitude irregularities (1-3 pixel variance) along the inner trailing edge; high-frequency, high-amplitude variance (10-25 pixels) at the distal tips due to external biological encrustations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves extending from the median notch to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast white pixels located at the distal edges of both lobes. Five distinct, small circular white pixel clusters are distributed on the ventral surface of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple parallel diagonal linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the left lobe, oriented at a 45-degree angle relative to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization at the lateral tips; parallel linear rake marks on the left lobe; multiple small circular scars across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular distal tip silhouettes caused by protruding biological growth extending beyond the anatomical skin boundary.
